permissions.defaultCeiling.description: The ceiling a pairing gives when none is chosen.

permissions.unattended.mode.description: The mode of every unattended run that names none (a routine or bot without an override, a completions request without a mode): acceptEdits or bypassPermissions.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

permissions.unattended.bypassAcknowledge.description: When bypassPermissions was first acknowledged as the unattended mode; null until it has been. Recorded by the environment, never set directly.

unit.description: What a duration is counted in: minutes, hours or days.

anyOf.description: A duration: 1 to 1000 minutes, hours or days.
A parked prompt waits until it is answered; a denylist prompt a Claude run waits on is closed, and its call denied, after 24.8 days, the longest its tool hook can wait.

permissions.parkedPrompt.ttl.description: How long a parked prompt waits before it is denied and its run continues: a duration, or never.

permissions.containment.default.description: The containment level of a run whose session names none.

values.description: Every permission setting's value, by key; a key never set holds its preset.

level.description: Where a run may reach: off (nothing applied), workspace (writes only inside the workspace), workspace-no-network (and no network for the model's commands and fetches).

reason.description: Null: the level can be enforced here.

cause.description: Null: the level can be enforced here.

level.description: Where a run may reach: off (nothing applied), workspace (writes only inside the workspace), workspace-no-network (and no network for the model's commands and fetches).

reason.description: Why the level cannot be enforced here, for people, in the harness's words.

cause.description: Why a containment level cannot be enforced. First the seven the probe finds: binary_missing (bwrap or sandbox-exec), userns_blocked (the kernel), apparmor, seccomp, socat_missing, failed (the mechanism failed otherwise), platform (none on it). Then adapter (the adapter does not enforce containment), probe_failed (the probe itself failed), not_probed (the probe not run).

detail.description: What the mechanism's own command printed when it failed, verbatim, for whoever debugs it (#1756); kept out of the reason, which a client shows first. Absent when no command was run or the environment predates it.

items.description: Whether this environment can enforce a containment level and, when it cannot, why, for people and as a cause.

levels.description: Each containment level, off first, and whether this environment can enforce it.

anyOf.description: What enforces a workspace containment level: seatbelt (macOS) or bubblewrap (Linux and WSL2).

mechanism.description: What enforces the workspace levels here; null when neither can be enforced.

declared.description: Whether the install declared the container: its compose sets the marker variable AGENT_HARNESS_CONTAINER.

detected.description: Whether a container runtime's marker was found: /.dockerenv, /run/.containerenv, or a container runtime in PID 1's cgroup.

container.description: The container the environment runs in: the operator's outer boundary, which enforces no containment level.

containment.description: What this environment can enforce: each containment level with its reason, the mechanism, and the container as the outer boundary.

isRoot.description: Whether the environment runs as root: always false, since it refuses to (ADR 0006); present so an exception would be loud.

denylist.description: How many entries each section of the denylist holds, enabled or not.
